topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stood there, the space where my childhood tree once stood now a vacant plot, the ground disturbed, the air still. It wasn’t just a tree; it was a witness to my youth,each ring a year of my life. The stump, fresh and jagged, was a stark reminder of time’s indifference. I traced the cut, thinking of the hours spent climbing, the secrets whispered to its leaves. Now, it’s as if those moments are as weightless as the air around me. They tell me progress demands change, but standing here, the cost feels immeasurable.
